outcome: maternal outcomes (HELLP syndrome, acute renal injury, pulmonary edema, maternal mortality)
fetal outcomes (preterm births, low birth weight, perinatal mortality)
cohort: 120 pregnant women diagnosed with antepartum eclampsia.
finding: Antepartum eclampsia significantly contributes to adverse maternal outcomes, including HELLP syndrome, acute renal injury, pulmonary edema, and mortality, and adverse fetal outcomes, such as preterm birth, low birth weight, and perinatal mortality, with young, primigravida women being particularly at risk.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean section was performed in 52.5% of cases, and vaginal delivery occurred in 45.8%.
